theme: Two-reader complete printed-row verification and cost pilot
question: Can proposal-assisted checking and independent blind reading verify every printed occurrence affordably, with anonymous adjudication, continuous controls and source-complete provenance?
outcome: Prepared 216 v2 target locators on seeded fresh PDF53,83,170, six column batches per role, 18 distinct hidden controls per role and 12 packets of 39 items. Final software/integrity checks pass 123/123. Actual reader evaluation remains Proposed: zero readings, zero staged real ledger rows/imports, accuracy and full-run monetary cost unknown.
challenge: V2 crops, field recognition and source recall are unreliable; full v2 extraction and future v3 payload unavailable. Source conventions can produce correlated reader errors, supplementary-page context weakens control concealment, and previous token/billing/adjudicator costs are absent.
remedy: Frozen-method pilot proposals, isolated role folders, source column/continuation inventories, exact strict-set validation, anonymous adjudication, unresolved candidate retention, occurrence-qualified merge, nullable usage ledger and interval-based workload scenarios. Preserve N preparation v1 and use amended pre-reading N v2 handoff; no old M endpoint changed.
retry_when: Coordinator supplies isolated real reader returns, actual usage/bills and adjudicator timing. Evaluate screening and affordability before full expansion; reviewed v3 geometry/adapter, refreshed controls and occurrence/object/surface concordances are required for later accepted corpus/ledger work.
